answer.subgoal: Explain the basic dictionary definition of Augmented Reality (AR) and its underlying components.
Describe the three primary characteristics required by the systemic definition of an AR system.
Analyze the detailed components (technology, 3D registration, sensory organs, and interaction) that define an AR system.
Compare and contrast Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR) by examining their defining characteristics and a practical example.
Review the various definitions of Mixed Reality (MR) and state the working assumption used in the course.
Summarize the key concepts, characteristics, and main differences between VR, AR, and MR systems discussed in the lecture.
Conclude the lecture and identify the topics that will be covered in subsequent lessons.

        *   Each segment must achieve *one sub-goal*.
        *   A sub-goal is something the learner can *do* (Explain, Describe, Compare, Solve).
        *   Avoid opening/closing remarks as segments.
        *   Cut where a sub-goal is *closed* and the next one *begins* (including the bridge).
        *   No cutting inside explanations, derivations, examples, or between Q&A.
        *   Each segment must stand alone (no dependency on prior unstated context).
